question: Where is the nearest fast food restaurant going from Anvil Arts Studio, Newland, NC toward Minnehaha Falls Guest House, Bat Cave, NC?
sql: WITH start_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Anvil Arts Studio%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NC%' LIMIT 1 ), end_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Minnehaha Falls Guest House%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NC%' LIMIT 1 ), target_azimuth_calc AS ( SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(s.geometry, e.geometry)) AS azimuth FROM start_point s, end_point e ), fast_food_candidates AS ( SELECT p.id, p.poi_name, p.geometry, ST_Distance(s.geometry::geography, p.geometry::geography) AS distance_from_start, degrees(ST_Azimuth(s.geometry, p.geometry)) AS restaurant_azimuth FROM pois p, start_point s WHERE p.amenity = 'fast_food' ) SELECT ffc.poi_name FROM fast_food_candidates ffc, target_azimuth_calc tac WHERE -- Calculate the absolute difference between the target azimuth and the restaurant's azimuth from the start point -- Normalize the difference to be between 0 and 180 degrees LEAST( ABS(ffc.restaurant_azimuth - tac.azimuth), 360 - ABS(ffc.restaurant_azimuth - tac.azimuth) ) <= 45 -- Filter for restaurants within +/- 45 degrees of the target direction ORDER BY ffc.distance_from_start ASC LIMIT 1;
